evidence.notes: The repaired source is normalized to exactly 32 x 20 x 32 meters with a floor-center pivot, one mesh, one primitive, 263626 vertices, 374298 triangles, one material, one texture, one embedded PNG, no external URIs, and no camera or light. The saved Spline scene contains one generated mesh rather than separable white shell objects. Inspection found the imported native light layer at alpha 0.4 even though the embedded texture and material factor are fully opaque; the scene was rebound to MF_OUTPOST_OPERATIONS_OPAQUE_NATIVE with light alpha 1.0. The source-model intake produced a non-overwriting v2 whose non-JSON chunks and embedded texture payload are identical to the prior clean source; the only permitted GLB JSON change is material 0 BLEND to OPAQUE. The original clean source and raw Spline export remain preserved. The final live Spline capture passed framing and exposure with the hero at approximately 83% of frame height and no crop. Runtime and mobile evidence remain UNKNOWN.
